_note: A status is {modifiers[], hooks[], dur} — the same shape as an item, a Resonance, a Pact, a keystone, a shrine curse and a Lattice node (§11.5). One type, one activation check, one place to debug. dur is in ticks (20 per second).

defs.name: Regen
defs._note: tick effects fire every `tickEvery` ticks (20 = once a second). Without that a 20 Hz regen out-heals the entire field — the battle fuzzer found the stall.

defs.name: Enraged
defs._note: Phase 1 of a boss (§6.3), and nothing about it says 'boss'. dur 'battle' rather than a tick count because a phase does not wear off — the fight only goes one way.

defs.name: Desperate
defs._note: Phase 2. It gives away as much as it gains — a cornered boss hits harder and takes more — so the last quarter of a boss fight is faster in both directions rather than simply longer.
